summary: The imported Politeia engine contains useful spatial, exchange, grid-input and output components, but the active Cycle 1 experiment implementation does not yet exist and the current engine cannot independently switch terrain movement and production channels.

covered: ESRI ASCII and binary grid loading

missing: landscape resolution exposed for all generated inputs
fixed-parameter lock between development and holdout stages

blocking_findings.finding: research/src/experiments/run_landscape_study.py does not exist; every experiment command in the plan is intentionally non-runnable until implemented.
blocking_findings.required_action: Implement the active experiment runner and analysis module under research/src/experiments/.

blocking_findings.finding: The only simulator source is inside research/imports/politeia-ds/, which is designated imported provenance rather than an active code root.
blocking_findings.required_action: Promote a minimal, versioned simulation core into the active experiment source tree without modifying the imported snapshot.

blocking_findings.finding: terrain_scale currently controls the grid potential used by both motion and production; E2 requires independently switchable channels.
blocking_findings.required_action: Add separate terrain_force_scale and terrain_production_scale controls and test all four factorial cells.

blocking_findings.finding: The active project directory has no .git repository, so a real commit_id cannot be bound and preflight must remain blocked.
blocking_findings.required_action: Restore or initialize the repository with the declared github and umi remotes before creating experiment manifests.

blocking_findings.finding: No implementation currently computes the preregistered spatial metrics or stationary-window diagnostics.
blocking_findings.required_action: Implement metric definitions with deterministic unit tests before server execution.

blocking_findings.finding: The imported engine is MPI/OpenMP C++ and contains no CUDA path; GPU use would currently be a false declaration.
blocking_findings.required_action: Use gpu_count=0 and CPU/MPI on umi for Cycle 1 unless an independently validated GPU implementation is later added.

non_blocking_assets: The engine accepts explicit initial-condition CSV files, so non-degenerate wealth perturbations can be preregistered.
The engine accepts arbitrary ASCII terrain grids, so exact matched landscapes can be generated outside the simulator.
Configuration supports fixed population by disabling reproduction and setting mortality mechanisms to zero or off.
Output directories are configurable and can be kept inside each job workspace.
Random seeds and time step are configurable.
implementation_order: Promote the minimal simulation core into active experiment source.
Separate terrain movement and production channels.
Implement matched-landscape generation and exact matching audit.
Implement spatial metrics, stationarity diagnostics and paired analysis.
Add deterministic unit tests and perform a second code-alignment review.
Create job manifests, bind the real commit, and run preflight on umi before any numerical execution.
